svg.title: Nephron components
svg.desc: Flat schematic section of one nephron: a renal corpuscle with glomerular capillary tuft, Bowman's capsule and arterioles, the proximal tubule, the thin and thick limbs of the loop of Henle returning to the corpuscle at the macula densa, the distal tubule and a collecting duct.
